name: Deposit-feeding benthos
description: Worms, clams and small crustaceans that eat the sediment itself. Functional group pooling the source's four deposit-feeder compartments - 'other polychaetes', the clam worm Nereis, macoma clams (Macoma spp.) and crustacean deposit feeders - all of which consume sediment bacteria in the source network. The main food of blue crabs and bottom-feeding fish. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the summed annual mean in mgC/m2.
